summary: No Critical or High findings: no injection, no auth bypass, no secret exposure, and the AI scoring path treats model input as untrusted correctly. The one path to real impact is availability — /api/status and /api/portfolio/{id} carry no rate limit and both hold one of 20 pool connections with no acquire timeout, and /api/status is Railway's healthcheck, so an anonymous flood can restart the service into a failed deploy. Fix that first (~30 min), then reconcile the two conflicting notions of client IP between rate_limit.py and analytics.py.

items.fix: Add @limiter.limit to /api/status and /api/portfolio/{share_id} and pass a timeout to pool.acquire() (or create_pool(timeout=5.0)). Separately, pin FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS to Railway's proxy CIDR and make analytics._client_ip use request.client.host instead of the raw header.
